params.name: board
params.description: Board directory short name (e.g. `a`, `b`, `g`, `pol`, `po`, `v`). The full list of valid values is the `board` field on each entry in `/boards.json`.

params.name: page
params.description: Index page number, starting at `1`. The maximum value is the `pages` field on the matching entry in `/boards.json` (commonly 10 or 15).

items.docs: Returns a single index page for the given board. Each index page contains an array of threads, and each thread contains its OP plus a small number of preview replies. The maximum page number for a board comes from the `pages` field on the matching entry in `/boards.json`.
